name: Villastar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above and red below with a red triangle at the fly, charged with a white tower at the hoist and two white Maltese crosses at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Villastar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two Maltese crosses at the upper and lower fly
